title: RBI Officer Grade-B Phase-II Admit Card 2026
postName: Officers in Grade B (DR) – Phase-II General/DEPR/DSIM
vacancyDetails: About 60 Grade B (DR) vacancies across General, DEPR and DSIM streams
qualification: As per stream – Graduation/Post-graduation criteria in RBI Grade B 2026 notification
ageLimit: As per RBI Grade B age rules (stream-wise)
applicationFee: As per RBI Grade B fee structure
documentsRequired: Registration number & password/DOB; printed Phase-II call letter; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://opportunities.rbi.org.in or rbi.org.in
2. Open Call Letters / Phase-II Admit Card
3. Login with registration credentials
4. Download Information Handout + Admit Card
5. Appear for Phase-II on 25-26 July 2026
shortDescription: RBI Grade B Phase-II Admit Card 2026 released on 15 July for exam on 25-26 July 2026. Download from opportunities.rbi.org.in.
content:
The Reserve Bank of India has released the Phase-II Admit Card for Officers in Grade B (DR) – Panel Year 2026 on 15 July 2026.

Phase-II examination: 25 and 26 July 2026 for General / DEPR / DSIM streams. Phase-I was held on 13–14 June 2026.

  • Vacancies: about 60
  • Download admit card and information handout from RBI Opportunities portal
  • Mandatory: printed call letter + original photo ID
